page_title: LEI 1-3 NOT | Leicester v Nottingham Forest 25/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Craig Pawson is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham) disagrees with the decision of the referee and is given a yellow card.
90+5' Issahaku Fatawu (Leicester) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
90+4' Boubakary Soumare (Leicester) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Craig Pawson didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
90+3' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Leicester, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+3' A player from Nottingham commits a rough challenge. Craig Pawson blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
90+1' Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the right post.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' The ball goes out of play. Leicester are awarded a corner kick.
90' One of the players from Nottingham times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
88' Craig Pawson shows a yellow card to Jordan Ayew (Leicester) for a tough tackle.
88' Issahaku Fatawu (Leicester) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
86' Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Matz Sels intercepts the ball.
85' Jota Silva (Nottingham) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post.
84' The ball is out of play. Nottingham will take a throw-in.
81' Chris Wood will be replaced by Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham).
78' Today's referee Craig Pawson rightly decides to book Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) for his harsh tackle.
78' The attendance is 31879.

77' Ramon Sosa (Nottingham) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
76' It is time for a substitution. Jota Silva (Nottingham) is on for Anthony Elanga.
76' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ramon Sosa (Nottingham) replacing Callum Hudson-Odoi.
75' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Wilfred Ndidi trots off the pitch and is replaced by Boubakary Soumare (Leicester).
74' Leicester force their opponents to concede a corner.
72' Here is a change. Alex Moreno is going off and Nuno Espirito Santo gives the last tactical orders to Morato (Nottingham).
72' The substitution has been made. Neco Williams (Nottingham) has replaced Elliot Anderson.
71' Craig Pawson blows his whistle and it's Ola Aina (Nottingham) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
70' Jordan Ayew (Leicester) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Matz Sels, who smothers the ball.
70' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he skies his shot high over the bar.
69' Nottingham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
68' Steven Cooper has decided to substitute Stephy Mavididi and he is replaced by Jordan Ayew (Leicester).
68' Substitution. Ricardo Pereira walks off the pitch and Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) comes on as a substitute.
68' Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) heads the ball towards goal, but the goalkeeper denies his effort by making an easy save.
67' Leicester take a short corner kick.
67' Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and Leicester manage to earn a corner.
65' The game is interrupted now, Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
63' A player from Leicester commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
60' 1 - 3 Goal! Chris Wood (Nottingham) is gifted a chance inside the box and makes no mistake putting the ball into the net with a fine header. 1:3.
59' Issahaku Fatawu (Leicester) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
58' The game is interrupted. Harry Winks (Leicester) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
58' Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
56' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) misses the left post by a whisker with a mid-range rebound. What a chance that was!
56' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) fires a brilliant shot from the edge of the box, but the effort rattles the right post! It could have been a superb goal.
56' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
55' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
55' A cross into the box from Ola Aina (Nottingham) is cleared.
52' Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker over the crossbar.
51' PENALTY APPEAL by Leicester, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
50' Neat passing move from Leicester in order to create new attacking opportunities.

46' Craig Pawson shows the yellow card to Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) for a heavy challenge.

45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' A lofted cross finds an unmarked Stephy Mavididi (Leicester), who leaps high and powers a header at goal. However, his header goes miles away of the left post. Poor effort.
42' Issahaku Fatawu (Leicester) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
41' Leicester will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
41' The foul by Alex Moreno (Nottingham) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Craig Pawson.

40' The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
39' Leicester win a corner.
38' Issahaku Fatawu (Leicester) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
37' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nottingham comes to nothing.

37' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Mads Hermansen stops the ball from going inside the top right corner. Nottingham have been awarded a corner kick.
37' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the free kick from Anthony Elanga (Nottingham).
36' Nottingham have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
35' Ricardo Pereira (Leicester) sees a yellow card from Craig Pawson after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
33' Nottingham concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
30' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
30' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
29' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
28' Half-chance! Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) plays a pass into the box, but Mads Hermansen reacts well to snuff out the attack.
26' The resulting set piece from Nottingham is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

25' Well-positioned Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) was first to the rebound and fired in a shot towards the right post, but Mads Hermansen reacted superbly to keep the ball out. The fans could not believe their eyes. It was a miraculous stop! Nottingham will take a corner kick.
25' The referee points to the corner flag and Nottingham will take a corner.
23' 1 - 1 Goal! Jamie Vardy (Leicester) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and fires the ball inside the back of the net.
22' Craig Pawson has a clear sight and sees a foul from Elliot Anderson (Nottingham).
21' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
20' The referee signals a corner kick to Leicester.
19' A player from Leicester pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.

16' 0 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Ryan Yates (Nottingham) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Mads Hermansen. 0:1.
16' It will be a corner kick for Nottingham.
16' Ola Aina (Nottingham) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
14' It's a throw-in for Leicester.
11' The ball is cleared after Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
9' Leicester fail to score from a corner as Matz Sels (Nottingham) leaps to collect the ball.

9' Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Leicester win a corner kick.
8' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) meets a cross inside the box, but Mads Hermansen wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
6' Nottingham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

6' Alex Moreno (Nottingham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Corner kick. Nottingham will have an opportunity.
4' Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
2' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.
2' Craig Pawson blows his whistle and signals a foul after Issahaku Fatawu (Leicester) brought his opponent down.
